name: Ironheights
description: Local static scanner for AI agent skills (OpenClaw/ClawHub, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) and MCP configs. The stdio MCP server lets a client check a skill before installing it (check_skill returns a fail-closed allow/blocked decision with grade, findings and a receipt), compare a shortlist, detect MCP tool-description drift and check a threat model. Rule-based and early-stage; no API key or network service needed.
author: Frank-Masciopinto
